messages.author: 5671646cea5d905d
messages.subject: triploid SSR data entry
parts: I have used POPPR on diploid SSR data and have been successful. Thanks it is a great tool. I would appreciate advice on the entry of triploid SSR data. I generated a file in Genalex format but with three columns per locus instead of two and then tried to import using read.genalex and setting the ploidy to 3 but kept generating an error message (sorry I did not make a note of it).   Could you provide a sample dataset and specific instructions on how to get triploid data in please. BTW the triploid example on Shiny R works fine. Cheers  David

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: triploid SSR data entry
parts:
Hello David,

The solution to your problem lies within the development version of poppr. You can install it from github by following the instructions here: https://github.com/grunwaldlab/poppr/tree/devel#stable-and-development-versions.

The development version includes features to help with the import and analysis of polyploid data. The data will be imported as you expect, with three columns instead of two per locus, except that you must specify missing data as "0". An example data set is located here: https://gist.github.com/zkamvar/778da43e364ff94ad728 (The data from the genoid github).

Download it, save it, and read it in with:

gen <- read.genalex('genoid-infestans.csv', ploidy = 3)

In the current implementation, multilocus genotype calculations, Bruvo's distance, and the index of association will work as expected. All of the data manipulation functions will also work as expected. Any calculation of statistics based on allele frequencies outside of those functions will not work at the moment.

Cheers,

Zhian
